stories.headline: Why did Samsung back Mistral?
stories.summary: French AI startup Mistral has confirmed a –3bn Series D funding round at a post-money valuation of over –21bn. The round, which reportedly includes backing from Samsung, represents one of the largest fundraises ever for a European technology company.

stories.headline: The most active growth equity investors in Europe
stories.summary: Sifted has highlighted the most active growth equity investors in Europe's diverse growth-stage market. Notably, the European Investment Fund (EIF) has launched a new –15 billion fund of funds designed to back 100 growth-stage venture capital firms across the region. This initiative aims to significantly boost late-stage funding availability for European technology startups.

stories.headline: Laptop-slinger Framework refunding customers who paid top dollar for RAM
stories.summary: Laptop manufacturer Framework is refunding customers who ordered its Laptop 13 Pro with 64GB of RAM after previously downgrading their orders to 32GB due to a massive spike in LPCAMM2 memory costs. The company has since secured a limited quantity of Micron 32GB and 64GB modules at a lower cost, allowing them to fulfill the original specifications and refund the price difference to affected buyers.
